compiled_state.title: Create design-lint.sh audit command and DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md documentation
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
- dd-3: dso design-lint --report runs full-file lint and emits per-violation-class count to stdout
- dd-4: DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md exists with Pinned CLI Version heading
- dd-5: dso design-lint --report auto-discoverable via /dso:quick-ref

## Implementation
1. Create plugins/dso/scripts/design-lint.sh — the audit command wrapper:
   - Reads DESIGN.md path from config via read-config.sh design.design_notes_path
   - Runs npx --yes @google/design.md@<pinned-version> lint against the full file (not diff-only)
   - With --report flag: parses output and emits per-violation-class count to stdout
   - Without --report: passthrough to the underlying linter
   - chmod +x
2. Create plugins/dso/docs/DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md with:
   - ## Pinned CLI Version heading (documenting the pinned @google/design.md version)
   - Audit command usage documentation
   - Expected behavior when DESIGN.md is absent

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass — Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh
- [ ] Script exists and executable — Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/design-lint.sh
- [ ] DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md exists with Pinned CLI Version heading — Verify: grep -q 'Pinned CLI Version' plugins/dso/docs/DESIGN-MD-REFERENCE.md
- [ ] Script auto-discoverable — Verify: .claude/scripts/dso design-lint --help 2>&1 | head -1
- [ ] .test-index updated with RED marker — Verify: grep '\[test_design_lint\]' .test-index

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user
